summary: In-app feedback that creates GitHub Issues with screenshots
content: In-app feedback that creates GitHub Issues with screenshots | BugDrop | Product Hunt Launching today BugDrop Launching today In-app feedback that creates GitHub Issues with screenshots 107 followers In-app feedback that creates GitHub Issues with screenshots 107 followers Visit website Screenshots and screen recording apps Free, open source website feedback widget. Users report bugs with screenshots and annotations; issues are created in GitHub automatically. One script tag, zero config, fully customizable to match any app. Overview Reviews Alternatives Built with Team More Free Launch tags: Open Source • User Experience • Developer Tools Launch Team / Built With Show more Show more Launching Today # 6 Day Rank Upvote • 106 points Follow BugDrop Add to collection Share Analytics Company Info bugdrop.dev GitHub BugDrop Info Launched in 2026 Forum p/bugdrop-2 Similar Products Loom Easily record and share videos 4.8 ( 158 reviews ) Team collaboration software Screenshots and screen recording apps Ybug Visual bug reporting and feedback tool 5.0 ( 1 review ) Screenshots and screen recording apps Customer support tools Beep! - New Era for Collaboration⚡️ Point out Anything on the Web & Share Feedback in Seconds 4.8 ( 10 reviews ) Project management software Team collaboration software CleanShot A superior way to capture your Mac's screen 4.9 ( 55 reviews ) File storage and sharing apps Screenshots and screen recording apps Marker.io Bug reporting made easy for everyone 4.8 ( 4 reviews ) Team collaboration software Screenshots and screen recording apps View more Subscribe Sign in Social X ElevenAgents by ElevenLabs — Scale conversations without scaling your team Scale conversations without scaling your team Promoted What do you think? … Login to comment Jeremy Watt meme search Maker 📌 I built BugDrop to make user feedback land where developers already work: GitHub Issues. Add one script tag to your app, install the GitHub Marketplace app, and users can report feedback from inside the product. BugDrop captures a screenshot, supports annotations, and creates a GitHub Issue in your repo. The widget is fully customizable, so you can match your app’s look and feel, change the button, theme, colors, labels, and tailor the questions you ask users. It works with public and private repositories, supports branch-protected repos, and is open source/MIT if you want to inspect or self-host it. I built it for my own apps first, and now BugDrop is the feedback workflow I use across everything I’m building.
